summary: [standards] Three guards prove less than their names say. (1) The debug assertions in emit and emit_with_data_and_meta check the registered reason and the row's exit/retryable of the top error only, not of error.details() entries (CliError::detail_errors); atip_reasons_07's fixture is one cause, so its loop over details checks the error itself only and F4's 'every details entry carries a registered reason' is unproved for several causes (after finding 1, an open-blocker plus false-success refusal is a ready two-cause fixture). Recurse over detail_errors() in the assertions. (2) atip_reasons_08's first test cannot fail: CliError::refused takes exit and retryable from the row and .reason() touches neither, so the comparison is row == row; the real guards are the emit assertion and the source scan for '.exit = ' / '.retryable = ' (which hold: pub fields, no writer in canon-cli/src). Say so in the test comment, or drive it through a code whose emission sets a field. (3) atip_reasons_02's 'registered reason raised by a site' accepts any source literal "NAME", so a reason that is also a code name (WRITE_FAILED, REPO_DENIED, PROMOTION_INVALID, CONFIG_INVALID) can never be reported dead; match .reason("NAME") / the reason tuples for those.
